en.tagline: Surf, chill and feel at home in Ahangama

copyBlocks.heading: A two-minute walk from Kabalana
copyBlocks.body:
Layday is small and new. There is a shared kitchen, plus a garden and terrace.

It is quiet, too. One guest called it "very quiet which was amazing".

copyBlocks.heading: Just one dorm
copyBlocks.body:
There is only the one dormitory. One guest wrote "super clean" and another "very clean". Someone else went as far as "absolutely spotless".

On Hostelworld it scores 10 out of 10 in every category (value for money, security, atmosphere, cleanliness, staff, location and facilities), though that is from ten reviews.

copyBlocks.heading: Newly built, and kept that way
copyBlocks.body: There is housekeeping every day. One guest called the beds "super comfy" and the showers "amazing". Two wrote that they stayed on longer than they had planned, and one was only supposed to stay a night and "ended up here a week".

copyBlocks.heading: The room
copyBlocks.body:
The dormitory is air-conditioned, with lockers and luggage storage. The shared kitchen has a kettle, a dishwasher and kitchenware, and there is a dining area. The showers are hot.

Rates change with the dates. The booking links show what is available.

copyBlocks.heading: Finding the door
copyBlocks.body: One guest found it "a little bit difficult to find", so here is the way in. Follow Google Maps. You will come to a large black gate; open it. Through the gate there is a wooden platform with a door through to the Layday area, to the right of the house.

copyBlocks.heading: Practicalities
copyBlocks.body:
Check-in is between 14:00 and 19:00, and check-out is by 14:00. Credit cards are not accepted. Taxes are included, and it is non-smoking.

WiFi is free, and so is the private parking. There is laundry, daily housekeeping, bicycles to rent and an airport shuttle, and pets can come at no extra charge.

testimonials.quote: LayDay is so wonderful! Newly built and so well designed, Rukshan has thought of everything. As a solo female traveller I felt totally safe - it's a peaceful little sanctuary in Ahangama, just a 2-min walk to Kabalana Beach and great food spots. Super comfy beds, loads of luggage space, amazing showers, and absolutely spotless. Rukshan and his family are so kind and he keeps it immaculate daily. I extended my stay way longer than expected and didn't want to leave - will 100% be back!
testimonials.author: Beth, England

testimonials.quote: Well located, very clean, good air conditioning and a great host! Layday Surf is just one dorm room with 4 bunk beds so it is very quiet which was amazing. A little bit difficult to find but the host was very responsive and promises a sign will be put up ASAP.
testimonials.author: Catherine, Australia

testimonials.quote: Seriously the best hostel I've stayed in throughout my 7 months travelling. I'm so sad I wasn't there for long because it was just so so nice. Super clean, nice style, the showers are great, it's cosy, there's a nice inside place to sit & hang out. The lovely family who own this make such an effort to be present and helpful. HIGHLY recommend!
testimonials.author: Jennine, England

testimonials.quote: New and clean, walking distance straight to the beach
testimonials.author: Akshay, Sri Lanka

testimonials.quote: Place is really it's quite small but absolutely great, very clean lots of room, beds are nice
